refused: Allow full access for this phone in Godmode on your computer.

devices.removeBody: It works on its own again, with the setup it has now. Its chats stay there.
devices.removeBodyWorking_one: It works on its own again, with the setup it has now. Its chats stay there; {{count}} is working right now.
devices.removeBodyWorking_other: It works on its own again, with the setup it has now. Its chats stay there; {{count}} are working right now.
devices.phoneWarning: This phone may lose its way to that computer.
devices.twinBody: The old runner on {{there}} is switched off and removed.
devices.twinMoves_one: Its chat moves to the app there.
devices.twinMoves_other: Its {{count}} chats move to the app there.
devices.twinStillStarts: Its runner still starts there: run “{{command}}” on {{there}} to switch it off.
devices.twinFailed: Couldn't switch off the runner on {{there}}

handoff.title: Hand off
handoff.label: Hand off work
handoff.body: Working chats stop here and continue there with everything they did so far.
handoff.idle: Nothing is working on this computer right now.
handoff.working_one: {{count}} chat is working on this computer.
handoff.working_other: {{count}} chats are working on this computer.

chats.title: Chats
chats.failover: Continue when a computer goes away

signIns.title: Browser sign-ins
signIns.label: Sign-ins
signIns.ownLine: With your saved logins, 2FA codes and passkeys.
signIns.seedLine: A computer new to a site copies the primary's sign-in.

older.title: Older runners
older.footer: Paired as runners before device groups. Their chats keep working here; new chats don't start there.
older.forget: Godmode forgets this runner, and the runner forgets this computer.
older.working_one: An agent is still working there.

leave.dissolveBody_one: The other computer works on its own again, with the setup it has now. Its chats stay there.
leave.dissolveBody_other: All {{count}} other computers work on their own again, with the setup they have now. Their chats stay there.
leave.leaveBody: This computer stops sharing with {{name}} and keeps a copy of the setup it has now.

invite.how: On the other Mac, open Godmode: Settings → Devices → Join with an invite. It works once.
invite.faceId: Show an invite for another computer
invite.locked: Confirm it's you to show the invite

join.label: Invite
join.runnerCode: That's a runner's pairing code. Paste an invite from another Mac; it starts with {{prefix}}
join.notInvite: That isn't an invite. It starts with {{prefix}}
join.expired: This invite has expired. Make a new one on the other Mac.
join.takesSetupPrimary: This computer takes the primary's setup
join.takesSetupBody: Its agents, logins, settings and paired phones replace the ones here; the chats here stay. This phone may have to be paired again.

cloud.trust: Only connect to a cloud you trust. It relays, and can see, everything you do through it.
cloud.approveHint: Approve this computer in your browser, only if the cloud shows exactly this code. Expires in {{time}}.
cloud.revokedHint: This computer was removed in the cloud.
cloud.inBrowserOff: Turn on the cloud link and browser access to open it in a browser.
cloud.browserDetail: Anyone signed in to your cloud account can do everything here, including running commands.
cloud.secretsDetail: Also unlocking the vault and seeing saved passwords and keys from the browser.
cloud.secretsBody: Whoever is signed in to your cloud account, and the people who run that cloud, could unlock the vault and see your passwords and keys.
cloud.cutsThisPhone: This phone reaches the computer through the cloud right now and loses its connection.
cloud.unlinkBody: Browsers and phones can't reach it through Godmode Cloud anymore, and the cloud forgets it. You can link it again later.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.cancelUntil: Everything keeps working until {{date}}. You can resume before then.
billing.cancelPeriod: Everything keeps working until the end of the period. You can resume before then.

connect.title: Connect an app
connect.name: Name
connect.claudeBody: Godmode adds itself to Claude Code on the computer, for every project.
connect.claudeMissing: Claude Code wasn't found on the computer: you get the command to run in a terminal where it is installed.
connect.manageDetail: Create and change agents, automations and tasks, and start their work.
connect.readDetail: See agents, tasks and what got done. Changes nothing.
connect.connectedBody: Godmode is in Claude Code now, for every project. Sessions already open pick it up after a restart.
connect.keyReadyBody: It is shown only this once. Copy what your app needs before you leave.
connect.tryTitle: Try it in a new Claude Code session
connect.tryPrompt: Create a Godmode agent that checks our competitors' prices every Monday morning and sends me a summary.
connect.installFailed: Godmode couldn't add itself to Claude Code: {{detail}}
connect.configHint: For apps set up with a JSON file (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf…).
connect.claudeHint: Adds Godmode to Claude Code for every project.
connect.urlHint: For apps that take an address and a header.
connect.cliHint: Lines that try the key with the godmode command line.
